{"consolidated_memory":"## DataTable Blank Render Issues - Four Distinct Occasions

**Component:** ui/components/DataTable.tsx (web ui)
**Common symptom across all:** blank render in the data table (empty tbody with no console error)
**Common repro:** open the table with a saved column layout
**Test coverage:** ui/components/DataTable.test.tsx
**Stack:** TypeScript

---

### OCCASION 1: [2026-03-28] Config Environment Race
**Trigger:** two requests raced on the same key  
**Root cause:** config loader reading the wrong environment file  
**Fix:** made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity  
**PR:** #1032 on branch fix/blank-render-1  
**Result:** p99 latency fell from 9.3 s to 117 ms  

### OCCASION 2: [2026-04-16] Lazy Initialization Race
**Trigger:** tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys  
**Root cause:** a race in lazy initialisation  
**Fix:** guarded the init with a double-checked lock  
**PR:** #2453 on branch fix/blank-render-2  
**Result:** backlog cleared 58 minutes after the deploy  

### OCCASION 3: [2026-05-06] Cache Invalidation Failure
**Trigger:** deeply nested inputs beyond six levels  
**Root cause:** a cache entry that was never invalidated on write  
**Fix:** invalidated the entry inside the write transaction  
**PR:** #5839 on branch fix/blank-render-3  
**Result:** cold start dropped 86 percent, to 781 ms  

### OCCASION 4: [2026-07-07] N+1 Query with Lazy Relation
**Trigger:** users sitting in a negative UTC offset  
**Root cause:** an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation  
**Fix:** prefetched the relation in a single query  
**PR:** #6086 on branch fix/blank-render-4  
**Result:** memory settled at 918 MB instead of climbing past 2 GB"}
